svg.title: Rules connect clinical chapters. — ICD-10-CM April 2026
svg.desc: A network of exact code mentions inside scoped instructions, with direction and scope preserved. All 22 chapters. The 24 strongest of 315 directed cross-chapter pairs are drawn; each weight counts literal occurrences of registered codes in scoped rule text. These are textual references, not patient associations or inferred coding rules.

text.tspan: A network of exact code mentions inside scoped instructions, with direction and scope preserved.

svg.text: ICD-10-CM:2026-04-01 • 809,979 exact facts • Graph views retain source scope
Read direction as: rule owner → code mentioned in its text.
The 24 drawn pairs account for 1,123 of 3,144 cross-chapter mentions. Stroke width follows the square root of the count.
Ranges and incomplete expressions remain verbatim in the full graph; they are not expanded into assumed code targets.
